13.sunriseWhen: From the downwind/crosswind and when cleared:
13.osoA: Proceed southwest from the west side of the Oso Bridge, ½ WTD west of the Oso River
13.osoB: Turn to intercept the extended centerline of RWY 13 and report the initial
13.osoDetail: The PPT adds: RWY 13, proceed south over Main Side, then turn direct to the numbers.
13.initialA: At the Shrimp Ponds, turn left toward the southwest corner of the Cooling Ponds
13.initialB: Stay on the west side of Oso Creek and call "initial" over the Yorktown Bridge
13.depClimb: Fly runway heading, climb to 500' MSL, accelerate to 240 KIAS
13.depTurn: Turn eastbound to avoid the Power Plant; once feet wet, turn to cross Padre Island (~120°)

18.sunriseWhen: From the downwind/crosswind and when cleared:
18.osoA: Proceed southwest from the west side of the Oso Bridge, ½ WTD west of the Oso River
18.osoB: Turn to intercept the extended centerline of RWY 18 and report the initial
18.osoDetail: The PPT adds: RWY 18, proceed direct to the numbers.
18.initialA: At the Shrimp Ponds, turn left toward the southwest corner of the Cooling Ponds; maneuver ¼ WTD toward the pattern side
18.initialB: Stay on the west side of Oso Creek and call "initial" over the Yorktown Bridge
18.depClimb: Fly runway heading, climb to 500' MSL, accelerate to 240 KIAS
18.depTurn: Turn eastbound to avoid the Power Plant; once south of the Power Plant, turn to cross Padre Island (~120°)

31.osoA: Proceed southwest from the west side of the Oso Bridge, ½ WTD west of the Oso River, toward the southwest corner of the Cooling Ponds
31.osoB: Abeam the Cooling Ponds turn left along their southern edge; abeam the Power Plant report the initial (stay east of the Power Plant)
31.osoDetail: The PPT adds: proceed south past the Cooling Ponds, then turn east; continue east south of the Power Plant, then turn north.
31.initialB: Remain east of the Power Plant (do not overfly it), then turn inbound for the overhead
31.depClimb: Fly the reciprocal heading, descend to 500' MSL, accelerate to 240 KIAS
31.depTurn: Turn eastbound to avoid the Power Plant; once feet wet, turn to cross Padre Island (~120°)

36.osoA: Proceed southwest from the west side of the Oso Bridge, ½ WTD west of the Oso River, toward the southwest corner of the Cooling Ponds
36.osoB: Abeam the Cooling Ponds turn left along their southern edge; abeam the Power Plant report the initial (stay west of the Power Plant)
36.osoDetail: The PPT adds: proceed south past the Cooling Ponds, then turn east; remain west of the Power Plant.
36.initialB: Remain west of the Power Plant (do not overfly it), then turn inbound for the overhead
36.depClimb: Fly the reciprocal heading, descend to 500' MSL, accelerate to 240 KIAS
36.depTurn: Turn eastbound to avoid the Power Plant; once south of the Power Plant, turn to cross Padre Island (~120°)

info.title: Waldron at a glance
instructions: Unlit, daytime VFR touch and go only; Tower open and crash crew on station
Mon–Fri, from 30 min after KNGP opens until 1900 or sunset
RWY 13 and 18 right pattern; RWY 31 and 36 left pattern
Max 6 in the pattern (Tower supervisor may reduce it) · IFR arrivals not available (check with an instructor)
info.source: Binder, p. 47; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slides 48–51.

info.title: Pattern direction and ELPs (Wacky Waldron)
instructions: RWY 13: right · RWY 31: left · RWY 18: right · RWY 36: left
Pattern PPELs (PPEL/P) go the PATTERN direction
Full ELPs go OPPOSITE of the landing pattern

info.title: Warnings
instructions: Do NOT overfly the Waldron Power Plant
Remain south of the Flour Bluff Water Tower to stay clear of NAS runways
Roads run close to the runway ends
No Padre Island National Seashore overflight below 3,000' AGL
